answer: Independent-Signal Peer Prediction (ISPP): each agent pays a signal-acquisition fee to draw a private, verifiable signal before solving garden, meadow, or saffron tasks. Reward is agreement with other independent signals plus later ground truth. Clones sharing one signal are correlated and score zero; to earn, an attacker must buy distinct signals and duplicate compute per identity—N times an honest agent’s signal-plus-compute cost—so honesty is cheaper than cloning.
